ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region forms a wide, irregular 'butterfly' shape extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge. High-intensity regions dominate the lateral lobes. Two distinct low-intensity vertical parallel streaks are visible on the inner-left lobe. Three distinct low-intensity circular spots are located on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 42 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.20 relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with peak amplitudes ranging from 3-10 pixels. Serration density increases significantly at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a complex sigmoidal curve, showing concavity adjacent to the median notch and transitioning to pronounced convexity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Three distinct dark circular pixel clusters located on the mid-section of the right lobe. High-relief, high-contrast textured clusters are present at both distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel diagonal low-intensity linear marks visible on the high-intensity surface of the right lobe, oriented at approximately 45 degrees from the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular texture and high-contrast pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips indicating physical protrusion or external attachments. Multiple distinct circular pigmentation marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical mottling patterns at the interface of the central low-intensity region and the lateral high-intensity lobes.
